items.title: A 70-Year-Old With $1,000,000 in Hormel, AT&T and ONEOK Collects $4,230 a Month in Dividends. How Safe Is Each Check?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA hypothetical $1,000,000 split evenly across Hormel Foods, AT&T and ONEOK pays $50,759 a year in dividends, or $4,269 a month. ONEOK’s check looks safe and growing, AT&T’s looks safe but flat, and Hormel’s looks stretched.

items.title: National Fuel Gas Has Paid a Dividend for 124 Straight Years. Can It Keep Going?
items.summary: National Fuel is preparing to break into two companies, and management has not said a word about what happens to the payout afterward. Income investors face a quiet risk that could keep the record alive while shrinking the check.

items.title: How Much Does a 60-Year-Old Need Invested to Replace a $125,000 Salary With Dividends and Never Sell a Share?
items.summary: One rule, never sell a share, sounds bulletproof until you check what happened to these six high-yield holdings this year. One dividend was slashed, another switched its payment schedule, and a few funds shrank even as they kept paying.

items.title: Buy, Sell, or Hold? Tuesday’s Top Upgrades and Downgrades: Cloudflare, Deckers Outdoors, DraftKings, MongoDB, Nike, Oneok, Philip Morris International, Riot Platforms, Wix.com, and More
items.summary: A two-day rally built partly on short covering faces its first real test when October inflation data lands at 8:30 ET. Meanwhile, analysts flipped hard on Wix and DraftKings, while a surprise double upgrade lifted a bitcoin miner's target.

items.title: Devon Q3 Earnings Outpace Estimates on Higher Output, Revenues Miss
items.summary: DVN's Q3 earnings beat estimates as the Coterra merger drives higher production, but revenues fall short despite strong growth in oil and gas sales.

items.title: Plains All American Q3 Earnings Lag Estimates, Sales Increase Y/Y
items.summary: PAA Q3 results lag estimates despite a 31.1% sales increase, while higher pipeline volumes and the Cactus III acquisition boost EBITDA.

items.title: Occidental Petroleum to Release Q3 Earnings: What's in the Cards?
items.summary: OXY gears up for Q3 earnings, with strong domestic production, drilling efficiencies and lower interest costs likely to have supported profitability.

items.title: Sempra's Q3 Earnings Outpace Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
items.summary: SRE's Q3 earnings surge 26.1%, beating estimates as stronger Oncor equity earnings and infrastructure performance offset revenue weakness.
